## 2 · Training cost (Multivariate vs Per-channel)

`Per-channel` is the mean cost of one channel's model; `all channels` multiplies it by the channel count. Δ compares that total against Multivariate. The per-channel runs trained alongside other bands (8 trainings at a time), the multivariate ones one run at a time, so their times are contended and Δ is not a like-for-like cost; `frames/timing.csv` holds the uncontended estimate where the solo timing pass measured one (EMF, L336/O96).
